notes_title: v3: what changed, and what to check
notes: Checked against your four bikes. The 700c hybrids (Trek FX 7.2, Schwinn Trailway) use the adult hook. The kids' 20 in Nishiki and 16 in Dynacraft need their own hook: small wheels have their spokes much closer together, so it has a slimmer bar (16 mm across instead of 26), and its seat sits further out so the small tires hang clear of the plate. Both print on their side with no supports, and both use the same 8-hole plate. Your 2x4 shows wood in three hole rows, so use all 8 screws. Suggested layout: adult, kid, adult, kid, 18 in apart. A kid's handlebar hangs about 25 cm closer to the wall than an adult's, so they can overlap side to side. That needs about 6.5 ft of clear wall. Please check: (1) weigh each bike (stand on a scale holding it, minus your weight), especially the Schwinn; (2) count the front spokes on the two kids' bikes; (3) before screwing anything, hold each bike up where its hook would go and check pedals and bars clear their neighbours.
